page.overview:
Who is Roxanne?

Roxanne is a Baratie regular who was friendly with Sanji. It is not known whether Roxanne is on the left or right. キャラクター検索|trans-title=Roxanne Character Search|website=one-piece.com|access-date=August 27, 2026|lang=ja}}

She can be barely seen, but she is a young woman. She wears a skirt and blouse.

She apparently enjoys eating at the Baratie, since Sanji knows her by name.

She was seen returning with a friend to the Baratie, where Sanji greeted her by name and started flirting.
